provenance.method: CSS custom properties, font stacks, motif class names, glyph frequency and on-page copy read directly out of the canonical build. Nothing here is a generic fashion assumption.
provenance.note: Re-derive this file if the canonical site's design tokens change.

lineage.parentBrandMeaning: Ина Ангелова | Студио за пиърсинг — a piercing studio, not a fashion house
lineage.relationship: PINK MALL is an EVOLUTION of Pierciina, never a replacement. Y2K is the newer layer sitting on top of a retro/disco studio lineage that must remain visible.
sourceCopy: малки количества, много розово и две сестрички

designTarget.rule: 70/30. If the strange half exceeds 30% the asset stops selling; if it drops far below, the asset stops being PINK MALL.

y2kLayer.note: pinkChrome is a warm PINK chrome, not the cold silver chrome of generic AI fashion imagery.

palette.rule: Deep magenta, cream and warm gold carry the heritage. Hot pink is the Y2K accent on top of it, never the whole palette.

typography.rule: Display type is retro signage, not modern minimal sans. Bungee is the signature.

marquee.meaning: Scrolling signage is a core Pierciina device — shop-front lettering in motion.

neonRibbon.meaning: Soft neon light ribbons, warm not clinical.

billboard.meaning: Hero billboard staging — vintage boutique poster energy.

soft focus.meaning: Glow comes from soft warm gradients, not hard specular chrome.

vocabularyWeight.note: Measured word frequency in the canonical source. retro outweighs Y2K roughly 2:1 — the heritage is the base layer.

requiredAnchors: Y2K as an evolution of Pierciina, not a replacement of it
forbidden: minimal modern sans display type in place of retro signage

failureSignature.looksLike: Glossy pink luxury mall interior, cold chrome, modern sans signage, no marquee, no cream or gold, no visible Pierciina studio lineage.
